title: Proteins Annotation of Nano-DESI MSI Datasets
author: yang1832
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bm2rk8d6
materials: Create mass list from the averaged spectrum.
Obtain CID data from each sample.

steps.title: Calculate Charge State
steps.instruction: Determine the charge state of each multiply charged peak by analyzing the spacing between isotopic peaks.

steps.title: Calculate Exact Mass
steps.instruction: Calculate the exact mass of the peaks using the determined charge state and the m/z value.

steps.title: Assign Protein Peaks
steps.instruction: Assign peaks by matching the calculated exact mass and the CID spectrum against the protein databank.
